name: tento-folder
description: Folder layouts as data: check a directory against a folder.* tsh spec, or render the spec as a tree

check.description: Validate a directory (default .) against a folder.* tsh spec. Fails listing every violation; --report returns them as data instead
check.name: check

options.help: The directory to check (default: the current directory).
options.name: dir

options.help: Return the violations as data instead of failing on them.
options.name: report

show.description: Render a folder.* tsh spec as a tree
show.name: show
